status_meaning.complete: the group's required_output is produced by a tested path, with no known gap
status_meaning.partial: some extraction exists and is tested, but the group's required_output is not fully produced
status_meaning.custody_only: the original bytes are preserved and retrievable byte-identically, and nothing parses or converts them

custody_note: custody is universal in vNext: any bytes can be imported as a content-addressed source and survive an archive export/restore byte-identically (crates/archeaxis-archive/tests/raw_recovery.rs, and for a whole vault crates/archeaxis-archive/tests/obsidian_vault_roundtrip.rs). A custody_only row therefore states that preservation works and that parsing does not exist yet - it never claims conversion.
requirement_note: release_scope, formats and required_output are carried verbatim from the 2026-09-07 record and are re-checked against it, so the requirement cannot be quietly redefined to match what was built.

formats.implemented_now: the text route extracts the text and reports canonical line anchors, and the media type is now derived from the source name, so markdown, CSV, TSV, JSON and XML are dispatched as what they are (the worker declares seven accepted media types). The route also reports the structure it can really derive in loss_receipt.params.format: markdown headings with line numbers, wiki-link, embed, markdown-link, code-fence and list counts; CSV/TSV delimiter, rows, columns, header and ragged rows; JSON parse result with top-level type, key count and nested depth; XML parse result with root, element count and depth. A document that does not parse is still projected as text and the fact says parsed false with the reason, and the reason is added to the loss list
formats.gap: there is no local-model annotation, no code-symbol or language-aware parsing for source files, and no table or formula structure; the format facts describe the document, they are not a second addressing scheme, so anchors remain line based

formats.required_output: 快照、正文、链接、抓取时间、段落锚点
formats.implemented_now: an HTML file or a saved page is imported as a content-addressed source and survives export/restore byte-identically
formats.gap: nothing fetches a URL, and nothing extracts a snapshot, body text, links, a capture time or paragraph anchors

formats.required_output: 页面快照、正文、分页/滚动覆盖记录
formats.implemented_now: a saved dynamic page is imported and preserved as bytes like any other source
formats.gap: there is no browser or fetch client at all, so there is no snapshot, no pagination or scroll coverage record and no way to state what was not reached

formats.required_output: 原图、OCR框、阅读顺序、图示描述
formats.implemented_now: the image.ocr route runs real Tesseract and returns recognised text with canonical line anchors; the media type is derived from the source name and must be one the route accepts, so png, jpeg, tiff, webp and bmp are all dispatched as what they are (each verified end to end through the transport to the engine); OCR regions are reported as facts in the loss receipt params, and a blank image produces no invented text
formats.gap: reading order exists only as line order and there is no figure description; a file whose extension the Core cannot name (for example a clipboard capture with no extension) is refused rather than guessed at, so the caller must supply a name that says what the file is

formats.implemented_now: the pdf.extract route runs PyMuPDF, returns the text with canonical page/line anchors and coverage over lines, and reports what the engine really exposed in loss_receipt.params.structure: per-page character and engine-block counts, image references, engine text blocks with their bounding boxes and first lines, and tables the engine's own finder detects with their row and column counts. Engine chatter is captured into the receipt instead of being printed, because the stdio protocol is one JSON envelope per line
formats.gap: blocks are engine blocks rather than linguistic paragraphs and a table detection is a detection, not a guarantee; pages are reported as facts rather than as an addressing level in the structure, and there is no reading-order or column-layout model

formats.implemented_now: a page with no extractable text returns genuinely empty text plus an explicit loss entry naming OCR as the next route, the pages that need OCR are named in pages_without_text with their per-page character counts, the PDF route renders those pages to PNG and declares each one with its digest and size, and the Core verifies every digest, imports each page as its own source (named so the media derivation reads it as a PNG) and enqueues one image job per page - automatically, inside the same commit that completes the PDF job, so a scanned PDF chains into a real OCR job with no manual call and its recognised text lands in the store. Enqueueing is idempotent; a tampered render, a size mismatch and a name that tries to leave the transfer area are refused with a reason and leave no queued job behind, and a chaining failure is recorded as a machine receipt naming the reason while the PDF job keeps the success it earned
formats.gap: low-confidence regions are still not marked, because per-word confidence is kept for review and never presented as accuracy, and the chain is one step: the OCR result does not feed back into the page it came from

formats.required_output: 标题、段落、表、图片、来源位置
formats.implemented_now: a DOCX is imported and preserved as bytes with its sha256 and name
formats.gap: no DOCX parsing: headings, paragraphs, tables, images and source positions are all absent

formats.required_output: 幻灯片、文本、备注、图表引用
formats.implemented_now: a PPTX is imported and preserved as bytes with its sha256 and name
formats.gap: no slide, text, notes or chart-reference extraction

formats.implemented_now: an XLSX is imported and preserved as bytes with its sha256 and name
formats.gap: no sheet or cell extraction, and no formula text with its cached value

formats.required_output: 转写、片段/词时间、音轨、质量标记
formats.implemented_now: an audio file is imported and preserved as bytes with its sha256 and name
formats.gap: there is no ASR route at all: no transcript, no segment or word times, no track inventory and no quality marks

formats.required_output: 对齐的音轨、字幕、画面事件、采样覆盖
formats.implemented_now: a video file is imported and preserved as bytes with its sha256 and name
formats.gap: no media route exists: no aligned audio track, no subtitles, no frame events and no sampling coverage record

formats.implemented_now: a .canvas is resolved as the JSON document it is and the text route reports its nodes and edges as facts: node and edge counts, node types, duplicate node ids, and edges naming a node that does not exist (dangling) - an integrity measurement rather than a graph. SRT and VTT are resolved as the textual documents they are and the route reports their cue structure: cue count, first and last cue times, and whether the document is SRT or WebVTT, all explicitly detected by pattern rather than declared by media type. Bytes remain custody-preserved in every case
formats.gap: no time anchor and no canvas node or edge is stored as a structure or a relation: the reported times and the graph are receipt facts, so nothing yet links a cue or a node to knowledge, and navigation stays on line anchors

formats.required_output: 章节/邮件头/附件引用及结构
formats.implemented_now: these files are imported and preserved as bytes with their sha256 and name
formats.gap: no engine is wired for any of these formats: no chapter structure, no mail headers and no attachment references

formats.implemented_now: the original file is preserved as bytes, which is the part of the requirement that must never be lost
formats.gap: no converter is wired, so there is no converted counterpart and no loss report - a loss report is only honest when a conversion was actually attempted

formats.required_output: 容器到文件到知识的来源关系
formats.implemented_now: an archive file is imported and preserved as bytes like any other source
formats.gap: vNext does not traverse a container and has no container-to-file-to-knowledge relation; the legacy batch controller in app/ingestion/batch_controller.py belongs to the Green application and is a recovery reference only, not an implementation of this row

formats.required_output: 原生文件与派生预览、转换覆盖说明
formats.implemented_now: the native file is imported and preserved byte-identically; the boundary is deliberate rather than accidental
formats.gap: no derived preview and no conversion is attempted, so conversion coverage is stated as zero rather than implied - the requirement is that the original must not be lost to an impossible conversion, and that part holds
